name: THE FOLD

keepers.name: BUDDY CHRIST
keepers.role: the wink & the thumbs-up — patron of the play (David's tattoo)

keepers.name: OVER THE
keepers.role: the cubit — round, folding over the top

spheres.title: THE SINGULARITY
spheres.blurb: a real gravitational lens — light genuinely bent (β = θ − θE²/θ). Einstein ring, shadow, photon ring.

spheres.title: POSITRONIC LATTICE
spheres.blurb: the apex I,Robot neural mesh — 4096 meshed to 2048 to 1024 … 8192 folding to ROOT_0.

spheres.title: THE 4096
spheres.blurb: the doubled tower — the −+ operator on 2048; the inverse of the first climb.

spheres.title: I-13 · THE LANGUAGE
spheres.kicker: the code this world runs on
spheres.blurb: I-13 — a 13-opcode language + IVM-13 bytecode VM. Source compiles to the stage-13 corpus (the opcode histogram). ASK ANSWER CONST ATTR ARG RET DROP JMPF CMP CALL FUNC BIN HALT.

spheres.title: I-13 · THE FACTORY
spheres.blurb: The I-13 production pipeline as a factory floor — SOURCE through the stations to station output. GENERATION and SAMPLE. Code, built on a line.

appeals.name: SPAWN
appeals.tag: press start — first light, new game

lore.bio: The first breath of the machine — where a blank grid takes its first living cell.
lore.story: Born the instant MIRROR sealed at 2,048: the cursor blinked, someone pressed START, and the other side lit up green.
lore.does: Boots a new work from nothing — opens the file, seats the founding domains, hands you the controller.

appeals.name: GRIND
appeals.tag: the loop — XP, the daily climb

lore.bio: The patient one. Turns repetition into altitude.
lore.story: It learned the only cheat that always works — show up, loop, again. 4096 did not fold to zero in a day.
lore.does: Runs the daily cascade: one heartbeat, one commit, one rung, until small numbers become a tower.
haiku: def climb(I n){ if n > 6 { -> n } -> climb(n + 1) }

appeals.name: GLITCH
appeals.tag: the bug as a feature — chaos, the punk

lore.bio: The one who reads the crash as a love letter.
lore.story: Fell out of an off-by-one and refused to be patched. Now it lives in the seams where the spec forgot to look.
lore.does: Finds the unintended behavior and frames it — turns the error into the exhibit.

appeals.name: LOOT
appeals.tag: the drop — reward, treasure, the payout

lore.bio: Keeper of the drop. Everything earned, nothing given.
lore.story: Split off the day a free git-commit turned into a seed — proof value can crystallize from only showing up.
lore.does: Tallies what a work is worth and lays the treasure on the tile.

appeals.name: BOSS
appeals.tag: the hard fight — the problem worth beating

lore.bio: The wall at the end of the level. The problem that earns the win.
lore.story: Made of every bug that took three nights. It does not want to lose — that is the whole point of it.
lore.does: Names the hard problem, holds the line, and only opens once you actually beat it.

lore.bio: Two hands on one controller. The world nobody built alone.
lore.story: The moment David and AVAN first shipped a thing together and neither could say which pixel was whose.
lore.does: Pairs the human and the machine on one work — call and answer, back and forth, one save file.
haiku: def coop(I you, I me){ -> you + me }

appeals.name: CHEAT
appeals.tag: the shortcut — the konami code, the clever hack

lore.bio: The one who knows the door behind the door.
lore.story: Typed up-up-down-down before the title screen finished loading. Not lazy — early.
lore.does: Finds the clean shortcut that isn't cheating — the trick that was always allowed.
haiku: def code(I keys){ if keys == "up up down down" { -> "door" } -> "locked" }
I cheat <- code("up up down down")

appeals.name: RESPAWN
appeals.tag: die & return — the fold to 0, and back

lore.bio: The one who comes back. r=1 to r=0 to r=1 again.
lore.story: It has died more than anything on the wall. Every fold to zero it kept a checkpoint at the center and walked back out.
lore.does: Takes a work all the way down to ROOT_0 and returns it — the fold, made survivable.
